text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after our three-year journey 
together with Hokko Tarumae had reached a 
milestone—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to the 'Tarumae Boom,' Tomakomai 
City is bustling with tourists again 
today...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go ahead and ask a few questions 
right away. —Excuse me, where did you come 
from today?"

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I came all the way from Tokyo! I really 
wanted to see Tarumae-chan's hometown...! 
It's kind of like a pilgrimage.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so this is an anime pilgrimage~! 
You've got an amazing amount of merch! 
...Ah! May I ask those folks over there 
some questions too?

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I came from Sapporo. I'm planning to go 
eat a seafood rice bowl at the port later 
today. I saw it recommended on Umastagram 
and really wanted to try it!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! This looks delicious! Please, enjoy 
it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Uhm, as you can see, so many people have 
come to visit Hokko Tarumae's hometown!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Since there's a mini-live show scheduled 
for today, the crowd seems even bigger 
than usual! It's even trending on social 
media—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. I'm so happy to be able to perform 
live here again.
choice_data_list:
It's been since your first solo event, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...A lot of time has passed since 
then, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It feels kind of strange. Just the other 
day, it felt like you were right here 
checking if I was nervous, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ......You've really changed, haven't you?
choice_data_list:
You gave it your all... and you changed 
things.

You gave it your all... and you changed 
things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The migratory bird with paper wings 
departed from Tomakomai, conveyed 
countless feelings alongside her 
brilliance, and has now returned home to 
Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And it changed everything. The hearts of 
many people, and this very land of 
Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yet, there are things that never change.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Those are... my feelings for my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm far from Tomakomai... soaring 
out into the wide world...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Like a migratory bird, I will surely 
return.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "To Tomakomai. And—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Next to Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: —Hokko Tarumae-san! Please get ready!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The star of Tomakomai shines brightly 
today as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With feelings for her hometown shining 
brighter than anyone's held close to her 
heart. Toward an unseen future—
